selection.objective: max(correct - wrong) s.t. unknown accept rate <= max_far
selection.fit_on: none - argmax by request, for a live demo

note: Publish the argmax. Any completed sign whose top-1 label the classifier produced is shown, so a signer whose scores sit under the calibrated bar (measured: correct top-1 at 0.46-0.99 on a live camera) still sees the word. min_hand_frames and max_unknown are the only gates left: the model still abstains when it reads the window as no supported sign at all, which is what a wave or a hand resting in motion produces. There is no confidence floor, so a misread is shown rather than withheld, and the transcript is the place it gets corrected.
